player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Mastermind.
You need to find the code that is {code_length} digits long, each digit from 1 to {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
In your response, you can submit your guess in the following format: '[2 1 4 5]'.
After each guess, you will receive feedback in the form of black and white pegs.
A black peg indicates a correct digit in the correct position, while a white peg indicates a correct digit in the wrong position.
You have {max_turns} turns to guess the code.

invalid_move.wrong_format: De' mumappeddarang sibawa daftar nomoro iya ripassalaingeng spasi, ribungkusui rilaleng kurung persegi.
invalid_move.not_integers: Sininna entri'e waji mancaji bilangang makkalepu iya makkeguna.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Sininna nomoro'e waji engka pallawangenna 1 nenniyya {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Pura-pura tona nitarima {guess}. Coba'i to mpatarimai anu laen.

game_action.feedback: Submitted [{guess}]. Feedback: {black_pegs} black peg(s), {white_pegs} white peg(s).

outcome.win: Andi riakkai kode, manyalasa'i {black_pegs} dari {code_length} pasang coklat dengan bener.
outcome.turn_limit: Watang putarnge ripennoi. Naewaimo {percent} perseng nomoro'na sibawa makessing.
